detail.command: npm install > /tmp/cpa-install.log 2>&1; echo "install_exit=$?"; tail -8 /tmp/cpa-install.log; echo '--- typecheck ---'; npm run typecheck > /tmp/cpa-tc.log 2>&1; echo "typecheck_exit=$?"; tail -25 /tmp/cpa-tc.log; echo '--- vitest all ---'; npx vitest run --reporter=dot > /tmp/cpa-vt.log 2>&1; echo "vitest_exit=$?"; tail -55 /tmp/cpa-vt.log
